messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Abhishek,

Peergrowth's executive-search focus across the Middle East, including country managers, business-unit heads and C-suite leadership, aligns well with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates in Saudi Arabia and the UAE where growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
